card.name: Dosing instructions and preparation headings
card.fires_on: Small words and open parentheses inside dosing text, such as table titles, reconstitution steps, and missed-dose advice. It responds to "(" after a dose or volume heading, "re" in reconstituted, and "next" in missed-dose wording.

modes.label: Parenthesis after dose heading
modes.description: An opening bracket that follows a dosing table title or a concentration, where a qualifier comes next.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage for MEKINIST Tablets in Pediatric Patients<< (>>Weight-based) Body Weight Recommended Dosage

modes.label: Missed-dose wording
modes.description: The word "next" in advice that the next dose should be taken as scheduled.
modes.example: If a dose of ONGENTYS is missed, the<< next>> dose should be taken at the scheduled time
